description: The contracting authority is issuing this tender in relation to research activities carried out within the Carbon Transformation & Energy Control Hub (C TECH) project at AAU Energy. The project aims to establish a modular pilot and demonstration facility in Esbjerg for carbon capture, utilization, and storage (CCUS) and Power to X (PtX) technologies. The establishment of the facility is part of the project's overall objective to accelerate the development and demonstration of existing and emerging CCUS and Power to X technologies. title: Netherlands – Vehicles for the emergency services – Watertankwagens
description: De aanbestedende dienst is voornemens om een raamovereenkomst met één (1) opdrachtnemer te sluiten voor de levering van initieel acht (8) en optioneel twee (2) watertankwagens. De garantieperiode maakt integraal onderdeel uit van de opdracht en wordt altijd afgenomen. Het onderhoud na afloop van de garantieperiode kan optioneel worden afgenomen middels een service- en onderhoudsovereenkomst. Van de acht (8) initiële watertankwagens zijn zeven (7) watertankwagens bestemd voor Veiligheidsregio IJsselland en één (1) watertankwagen voor Veiligheidsregio Fryslân. Van deze initiële afname dienen uiterlijk eind Q2 2028 vijf (5) watertankwagens voor Veiligheidsregio IJsselland en één (1) watertankwagen voor Veiligheidsregio Fryslân te worden geleverd. De twee (2) resterende watertankwagens van de initiële bestelling zijn bestemd voor Veiligheidsregio IJsselland en hebben een voorziene leverdatum in 2029. De optie voor de levering van de twee (2) optionele watertankwagens in 2029 en het daarbij behorende optioneel af te nemen onderhoud is afhankelijk van de uitkomst van het bluswaterplan van de aanbestedende dienst. Daarnaast biedt de raamovereenkomst de mogelijkheid om gedurende de looptijd aanvullende watertankwagens af te nemen indien daar aanleiding toe bestaat, bijvoorbeeld als gevolg van total-loss of onherstelbare schade aan bestaande watertankwagens.

title: Denmark – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Udbud af udvikling af Den Veterinære Receptløsning
description: Indførelsen af “Lov om lægemidler, lov om apoteksvirksomhed og lov om dyrlæger” i 2006 skabte grundlag for at styrke de tekniske muligheder for receptudstedelse og udlevering af veterinære lægemidler til dyr i Danmark. Der har siden været bred opbakning til en fælles digital løsning for dyrlæger, apoteker, § 39 vet-forhandlere og myndigheder, senest fremhævet i Fødevare-Veterinæraftalen 2024-2027. I dag håndteres veterinære ordinationer fortsat i vidt omfang via papir, fax eller pdf. Det medfører manuelle arbejdsgange, øget risiko for fejl og mangelfuld dokumentation samt vanskeligere og mere ressourcekrævende myndighedskontrol. Formålet med udbuddet er derfor at Leverandøren skal udvikle Den Veterinære Receptløsning (DVR eller Løsningen), der skal forbedre sikkerheden og kvaliteten i hele processen fra udstedelse af recept til udlevering af lægemiddel. Løsningen skal give mulighed for at optimere arbejdsgange og skabe et ubrudt og beskyttet digitalt flow af receptdata og dermed at sikre både fortrolighed, integritet og sporbarhed til gavn for dyreejere, dyrlæger, apoteker og myndigheder. Hvert år udstedes der ca. 1,1 mio. recepter til dyr (produktionsdyr og hobbydyr). Danmark har i alt omkring 6.000 dyrlæger med autorisation, hvoraf ca. 2.650 er aktive dyrlæger fordelt på ca. 1.000 dyrlægepraksis. Alle autoriserede dyrlæger kan som udgangspunkt udskrive recepter. Lægemidler til dyr distribueres via landets apoteker samt særlige § 39-forhandlere. Lægemiddelstyrelsens liste over forhandlere af veterinære lægemidler til produktionsdyr omfatter aktuelt omkring 85 apoteker og et lille antal autoriserede virksomheder (pt. 4 § 39-forhandlere) med tilladelse og fagpersonale (farmaceuter og farmakonomer) til at sælge, udlevere og informere om medicin til produktionsdyr. Der findes ca. 45.000 landbrugsbedrifter med dyr, registreret i det Centrale Husdyrbrugsregister (CHR) hos Fødevarestyrelsen. Herudover har Danmark en stor population af hobbydyr og kæledyr. Det anslås, at der findes omkring 810.000 hunde og 730.000 katte i danske hjem. Hertil kommer cirka 177.000 heste, der primært holdes som hobby- og sportsdyr. Leverandøren skal udvikle den samlede Løsning, der skal bestå af DVR-løsningen og Stamdataløsningen. Udviklingsopgaven af DVR-løsningen består af tre hoveddele: 1. DVR-applikationen, som varetager den centrale forretningslogik, samt 2. DVR services, som udstiller de nødvendige services til brug for de eksterne anvendersystemer 3. DVR online (option), som udgør en webbrugergrænseflade for receptudstedelse Udviklingsopgaven af Stamdataløsningen omfatter tre hoveddele: 1. Stamdataindlæsere, som håndterer indlæsning af data fra stamdatakilder, 2. Stamdatadatabase, som opbevarer de konsoliderede stamdata, samt 3. Stamdata services, som udstiller stamdata til brug for DVR-løsningen og de eksterne anvendersystemer. Udbuddet omfatter tillige levering af de nødvendige services og integrationsmuligheder, der understøtter integration til relevante stamdatakilder samt eksterne anvendersystemers integration med DVR-løsningen, herunder dyrlægesystemer, § 39 vet-forhandlersystemer og apotekssystemer. De eksterne anvendersystemer er ikke en del af løsningen. Leverandøren skal endvidere levere en løsning, der understøtter sikkerhed og logning. Dette omfatter de sikkerheds- og logningsmekanismer, der er nødvendige for at beskytte receptdata og stamdata samt sikre sporbarhed i Løsningen. Udbuddet omfatter desuden vedligeholdelse og 2nd level support af Løsningen fra Overtagelsesdagen. Der skal endvidere leveres Hypercare i en begrænset periode efter idriftsættelsen. Vedligeholdelse og support skal ske i overensstemmelse med Kontrakten, herunder de fastsatte servicemål. Kontrakten indeholder desuden rammeaftalelignende elementer i form af bestillingsydelser og øvrige timebaserede ydelser, som vederlægges efter medgået tid på grundlag af de fastsatte timepriser. Timepriserne er knyttet til tre medarbejderkategorier med nærmere beskrevne kvalifikationer og erfaringsniveauer til rådighed for Kunden. Udbuddet gennemføres som et udbud med forhandling, jf. udbudslovens § 61 stk. 1, nr. a, idet ordregivers behov ikke kan imødekommes uden tilpasning af allerede tilgængelige løsninger. title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Neubau einer Forschungshalle für Automatisierung und Digitalisierung bahn- und verkehrsbetrieblicher Funktionen, Annaberg-Buchholz
description: Mit dem Gesamtvorhaben Smart Rail Connectivity Campus (SRCC) wollen die Technische Universität Chemnitz und die Stadt Annaberg-Buchholz am Standort Annaberg-Buchholz ein Zentrum für Forschung, Entwicklung, Erprobung und Befähigung zur Zulassung im Innovationsfeld Intelligenter Schienenverkehr (Smart Rail) etablieren. Die DB InfraGO und die DB RegioNetz Verkehrs GmbH begleiten diese Vorhaben aktiv. In Kooperation mit vielen weiteren Partnern aus Wissenschaft und Wirtschaft sollen Forschungs- und Entwicklungsarbeiten zur digitalisierten, vernetzten, automatisierten und nachhaltigen Mobilität geleistet werden. Das Vorhaben trägt zur Schaffung einer Forschungsinfrastruktur bei, die Alleinstellungsmerkmale aufweist und eine breite Palette von Forschungsaktivitäten aus einer systemischen und interdisziplinären Perspektive heraus ermöglicht. Zur Schaffung der notwendigen Forschungsvoraussetzungen ist der Neubau einer Forschungshalle mit Sozial- und Funktionsräumen am unteren Bahnhof in Annaberg-Buchholz vorgesehen, die dort an die Gleisanlagen der Erzgebirgsbahn angebunden ist. Die Einordnung und das Baufeld (grün umrandet) sind in der Abbildung links zu erkennen. Die in diesem Dokument beschriebenen Leistungen stellen funktionale Mindestanforderungen an die Forschungshalle mit Gleisanschluss und die zugehörigen Außenanlagen dar. Inhalt dieser Leistungsbeschreibung (hier: Funktionale Leistungsbeschreibung (nachfolgend abgekürzt mit "FLB")) sind Beschreibungen der Funktionen zur vollständigen Planung und der späteren Errichtung der betriebsbereiten und schlüssel-/bezugsfertigen Forschungshalle, der Gleisanlagen, der Außenbereiche mit Straßen, Wegen und Umzäunung (Außenanlagen) sowie die Freimachung des Baufeldes, der Abbruch der vorhandenen Oberflächen innerhalb des Baufeldes sowie eines Schuppens und von beräumten Kleingärten im nördlichen Teil des Areals unter Einhaltung aller gesetzlichen und technischen Anforderungen sowie Normen.

title: Germany – Expert witness services – Schachtanlage Asse II: Sachverständiger der atomrechtlichen Aufsicht nach § 20 AtG: Begutachtung von Fragestellungen in Bezug auf die Strahlenschutzinstrumentierung
description: Gegenstand des Auftrags ist die sachverständige Unterstützung des BASE bei der atomrechtlichen Aufsicht über die Schachtanlage Asse II gemäß § 20 AtG im Bereich der Strahlenschutzinstrumentierung. Die Leistungen umfassen insbesondere die fachliche Prüfung und Bewertung von Fragestellungen im Zusammenhang mit der Strahlenschutzinstrumentierung der Schachtanlage Asse II. Hierzu gehören insbesondere: - die Unterstützung bei atom- und strahlenschutzrechtlichen Verfahren zur Änderung der Strahlenschutzinstrumentierung und des zugehörigen betrieblichen Regelwerks, - die fachliche Bewertung von Änderungen, insbesondere hinsichtlich ihrer Wesentlichkeit im Sinne des Atomrechts, - die Prüfung und Bewertung vorgelegter Unterlagen und Daten hinsichtlich Schlüssigkeit, Nachvollziehbarkeit und fachlicher Richtigkeit, - die Begleitung wiederkehrender Prüfungen an Anlagenteilen, Systemen und Komponenten der Strahlenschutzinstrumentierung einschließlich der Dichtheitsprüfung umschlossener Strahlenquellen, - die Erstellung von Gutachten, Prüfberichten, Stellungnahmen und Protokollen zu den jeweiligen Prüfergebnissen sowie - die Unterstützung der atomrechtlichen Aufsicht bei Fragestellungen, die eine Prüfung oder Begutachtung vor Ort erfordern. Die Strahlenschutzinstrumentierung umfasst insbesondere Einrichtungen zur Ortsdosis- und Ortsdosisleistungsüberwachung, zu Oberflächenkontaminationsmessungen, zur Personendosimetrie und Inkorporationsüberwachung sowie zur Raumluft-, Abluft- und Immissionsüberwachung. Zur Wahrnehmung der Aufgaben, insbesondere zur Begleitung wiederkehrender Prüfungen, sind während der Vertragslaufzeit regelmäßig Vor-Ort-Termine und Befahrungen der Schachtanlage Asse II erforderlich. Eine nähere Projektbeschreibung, in der das Beschaffungsvorhaben eingehend erläutert wird, ist in der Vergabeunterlage „Leistungsbeschreibung“ enthalten.

title: Germany – Operation of a refuse site – (Technischer) Betrieb der Deponie Wiedenzhausen (Landkreis Dachau)
description: Gegenstand dieser Vergabe ist die Betriebsführung der Deponie Wiedenzhausen. Die im Jahr 1979 von der Regierung von Oberbayern genehmigte im Landkreis Dachau befindliche Deponie Wiedenzhausen befindet sich aktuell in der Stilllegungsphase. Ursprünglich wurden auf der Deponie Aluminiumschmelzschlacke und Aluminiumoxidstaub abgelagert. Nachdem die weitere Ablagerung von Schlacke unzulässig geworden war, erfolgte die Sanierung der Altbereiche sowie die nachträgliche Ausstattung bislang nicht abgedeckter Deponieabschnitte mit einer qualifizierten Oberflächenabdichtung. Infolge der Insolvenz der Betreibergesellschaft befindet sich die Deponie seit Anfang des Jahres 2022 in der Ersatzvornahme durch die Regierung von Oberbayern. Gegenstand der zu vergebenden Leistung ist die Wahrnehmung sämtlicher Aufgaben, die im Rahmen der (technischen) Betriebsführung einer Deponie während der Stilllegungs- und Nachsorgephase anfallen. description: This advanced notice is in response to the sources sought notice originally posted under N6339426R0007 on 02 February 2026 and updated on 09 February 2026. Based on the results of the sources sought notice, the Government anticipates issuing solicitation N6339427R0003 as a full and open competition. The Naval Surface Warfare Center, Port Hueneme Division anticipates a contract requirement for the procurement of the Outer Board Assembly, Lower A-Side part number (P/N) 6539759-9, Outboard Assembly, Lower B-Side P/N 6539761-9, Lower Outboard Structure A-Side, P/N 5599357-39, and Structure Lower B-Side P/N 5599356-19 for the Vertical Launching System (VLS). These are Naval Sea Systems Command part numbers. The VLS structural assembly integrates the outer boards, lower boards, plenum, uptake assemblies, and internal supports into a single, rigid, shock-qualified launcher module. The primary North American Industry Classification System code for this procurement is 336414, with a Size Standard of 1300 employees. The anticipated period of performance is five years, consisting of a five-year ordering period. The Government anticipates awarding a Single Award Firm-Fixed-Price Indefinite-Delivery-Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract. The Request for Proposal (RFP) is anticipated to be issued on or about December 2026. Drawings will be provided via DoD SAFE to all Joint Certification Program-registered requestors once the RFP has been posted to Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment. All responsible sources may submit a bid, proposal, or quotation for consideration by the agency. The Government will not reimburse respondents costs associated with submitting questions or providing information in response to this notice. title: Rammeavtale elektromateriell
description: Oppdragsgiver forvalter flere kirker, gravplasser og øvrige eiendommer, noe som medfører at oppdragsgiver har et løpende behov for elektromateriell til drift og vedlikehold. Oppdragsgiver skal inngå en rammeavtale med én leverandør, og formålet med anskaffelsen er å sikre at Bergen kirkelige fellesråd får dekket sitt samlede behov for elektromateriell på en effektiv og hensiktsmessig måte. Ved større prosjekter vil oppdragsgiver forespørre leverandør om prosjektpriser, hvor også tilkjøring og levering vil være en viktig del av oppdraget.Oppdragsgiver har i dag en tilsvarende rammeavtale med Onninen som utløper januar 2027. Forventet oppstart på denne rammeavtalen er derfor januar 2027. Avtalen inngås for en periode på to (2) år fra signeringsdato. Oppdragsgiver har opsjon til å forlenge avtalen med ett (1) år av gangen, i inntil to (2) ganger. Maksimal samlet avtaleperiode er fire (4) år. Opsjoner utløses ved skriftlig beskjed av oppdragsgiver minimum tre (3) måneder før utløp. Avtalen opphører automatisk ved utløp av avtaleperioden. Dersom alle opsjoner benyttes er anskaffelsens forventede totalverdi kr. 10 000 000, med et årlig forventede uttak på kr. 2 5000 000. Maksimal kontraktsverdi er kr. 15 000 000. Summen er beregnet på historiske data.

title: Norway – Electrical materials – Framework agreement for electrical material
description: The contracting authority manages several churches, cemeteries and other properties, which means that the contracting authority has a continual need for electrical material for operation and maintenance. The contracting authority shall enter into a framework agreement with one tenderer and the objective of the procurement is to ensure that Bergen Church Council can meet its total need for electro material in an efficient and appropriate manner. The contracting authority will ask the tenderer for major projects on project prices, where delivery and delivery will also be an important part of the assignment. The contracting authority currently has an equivalent framework agreement with Onninen that expires in January 2027. The expected start-up of this framework agreement is therefore January 2027. The contract will be signed for a period of two (2) years from when the contract is signed. The contracting authority has the option to extend the contract for one (1) year at a time, for up to two (2) times. The total maximum agreement period is four (4) years. The options will be taken up by written notification by the contracting authority at least three (3) months before the expiry date. The contract will automatically expire at the end of the agreement period. If all options are utilised, the procurement ́s expected total value is NOK 100,000,000 excluding VAT. 10,000,000, with an annual expected call-off of NOK 10,000,000. 2 5000 000. The maximum contract value is NOK 100,000,000 excluding VAT 15 000 000. The sum is based on historical data.

title: Ireland – Repair and maintenance services of mechanical building installations – fabrication and Maintenance
description: Dublin Bus is looking to establish a fabrication and maintenance framework with appropriate Contractors to carry out repair and maintenance at each of its facilities which consists of All locations throughout Dublin City and County. Dublin Bus wishes to establish a contract, which will provide ongoing basic fabrication and maintenance, repair and small new-works at all Dublin Bus locations There will be 2 lots under this tender. Lot 1 will account for most of the work; mechanical maintenance (fabrication) works of all facilities and small new installations (less than €15,000 ex VAT). This will be a direct-award contract to the successful contractor. Lot 1 contract value is estimated to be ca. €280k per annum excluding VAT. Lot 2 will be for larger new installation (greater than €15,000 ex VAT) additional works beyond the scope of Lot 1. It is intended to form a framework and run mini competitions for works in this category. No previous call-offs were made under this Lot however; it is included in the new framework to accommodate future requirements falling within this scope. These sums are aligned with ASC funding currently. In order to provide for potential future expanded requirements in this area, the overall framework value over the maximum duration will be advertised at a value of €1.3M to provide adequate headroom in the contract award mechanism should additional projects or major unforeseen repair work arise. This value will be conditional on budget availability and does not represent a commitment to spend. The initial contract will be for three years with an option to extend for a further 12 months

title: Ireland – Construction work – The Design and Build of 30 No. Apartment units including all necessary site development works at Mary Street, Limerick City.
description: The proposed development will consist of: a) Residential Development The construction of a new residential development comprising 30 apartment units within two interconnected blocks ranging from 3 to 5 storeys in height, including: 9 no. studio apartments; 7 no. one-bedroom apartments; 10 no. two-bedroom apartments; and 4 no. three-bedroom apartments. The development will comprise: A 3 to 5 storey block fronting Mary Street; and A 4 to 5 storey block fronting Sraid Seamus O Cinneide. Both blocks will be served by a single central stair and lift core and will include ancillary accommodation comprising: Secure storage for 42 resident bicycle parking spaces; A communal refuse storage area; and A resident storage room. b) Site Development and External Works Site works will include the removal of the existing palisade perimeter fencing and its replacement with the proposed development together with associated landscaping and public realm enhancements. The works will comprise: A new secure communal open space for residents on Sraid Seamus O Cinneide; 2 no. car parking spaces for use by the Pigeon Club, accessed from Sraid Seamus O Cinneide; Public realm improvements along Mary Street and Sraid Seamus O Cinneide, including replacement footpaths; Provision of 18 no. visitor bicycle parking spaces on Mary Street; New pedestrian-only access lanes connecting Mary Street and Sraid Seamus O Cinneide and providing side access to the development; New public lighting; Connections to the existing foul and surface water drainage networks; and All associated site development, utility, boundary treatment and landscaping works. c) Archaeological Works The proposed development will include archaeological excavation and recording works associated with the existing in-situ walls recorded under the Sites and Monuments Record (SMR Ref. LI005-0017148), together with all related archaeological monitoring and mitigation measures as required.

title: Finland – Vaccines for veterinary medicine – Oral rabies vaccines
description: Subject of Procurement The procurement concerns oral rabies vaccine baits intended for the vaccination of foxes and raccoon dogs. The purpose of the procurement is to prevent the introduction and spread of rabies in Finland and to maintain Finland's rabies-free status.The estimated quantity to be purchased under the contract is 360,000 vaccine baits in 2027 and 180,000 vaccine baits annually thereafter. In 2027, the vaccine baits shall be delivered by the Supplier to Helsinki, Finland, in two deliveries: 180,000 vaccine baits in March and 180,000 vaccine baits in August. In each subsequent year, 180,000 vaccine baits shall be delivered once, in August.The Finnish Food Authority will be responsible for the subsequent distribution of the vaccine baits within the vaccination area. The subject of the procurement and requirements of the procurement are described in more detail in this invitation to tender and its appendices.

title: Fully Managed Renal Dialysis Satellite Unit in Crawley Area
description: South West London Procurement Partnership (SWLPP), on behalf of Epsom and St Helier University Hospitals NHS Trust (ESTH) (the "Authority") invites tenders from experienced and qualified organizations for the provision of a fully managed renal satellite dialysis satellite unit located in the Crawley area, providing all the facilities, equipment, consumables and renal nursing services required to deliver a fully managed renal dialysis satellite unit. The objective of this competitive tender exercise is to select a single provider capable of delivering high-quality, cost-effective solutions in accordance with the specifications detailed in the Tender Pack. A detailed Specification of Requirements is included in the Tender Documentation. Please note, the current Crawley renal dialysis satellite unit is a joint venture between Epsom and St Helier University Hospitals NHS Trust (ESTH) and University Hospitals Sussex NHS Foundation Trust (UHSx). Patients from both Trusts currently receive treatment at the Crawley unit. At the time of the pre-market engagement, both Trusts fully intended reprocuring the Crawley unit jointly. However, it has since been agreed that each Trust will independently procure a solution for their own cohort of patients from the Crawley area. This tender will only include activity numbers for patients under the treatment of Epsom and St Helier University Hospitals NHS Trust (ESTH). Current and estimated numbers will be included in the Tender Documentation. Additional information: To express interest and participate in the tender, please register and apply via Atamis e-sourcing portal https://health-family.force.com/s/Welcome. title: Finland – Boring machinery – Sähköisen monitoimikairakoneen hankinta 2027
description: Espoon kaupunki (myöhemmin myös Tilaaja) pyytää tarjouksia sähköisestä monitoimikairakoneesta. Hankinnan kohteena on uusi sähköinen monitoimikairakone varusteineen käyttökuntoon saatettuna ja toimitettuna Tilaajan määrittelemään sijaintiin Espooseen. Monitoimikairakoneen tulee soveltua Espoon kaupungin geotekniikkayksikön tarpeisiin. Hankinnassa ei sovelleta puitejärjestelyä. Tarkempi kuvaus hankinnan sisällöstä on tarjouspyynnön liitteellä 1. "Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus". Tilaaja valitsee kilpailutuksen perusteella sopimustoimittajaksi yhden (1) toimittajan ja yhden (1) varatoimittajan. Hankinnan valmistelu Hankintayksikkö on valmistellut hankintaa arvioimalla markkinoilla olevia vaihtoehtoja ja kilpailuolosuhteita sekä hankinnan toteuttamistapoja. Markkinakartoitusilmoitus on julkaistu HILMA:ssa 23.09.2026. Markkinakartoituksessa on kuultu alan toimijoita kirjallisesti ja markkinavuoropuhelun kautta, hyödynnetty asiantuntijanäkemyksiä, arvioitu hankinnan jakamista osiin sekä eri toteutusmalleja. Markkinakartoitus on toteutettu siten, ettei yksittäistä toimittajaa ole suosittu ja kartoituksessa on toimittu tasapuolisesti ja avoimesti. Kartoituksen keskeiset havainnot ovat Markkinoilla toimii vain rajallinen määrä toimijoita. Markkinakartoituksessa tunnistettiin kaksi (2) potentiaalista toimittajaa, joiden tarjonta on pääpiirteissään samankaltaista. Sähköisesti toimiva monitoimikairakone on toimialalla suhteellisen uusi ratkaisu, minkä vuoksi markkina on vielä melko kapea. Markkinavuoropuheluun ilmoittautuneet tarjoajat ovat toimineet alalla pitkään ja vakiinnuttaneet asemansa erityisesti perinteisten sekä sähköisten monitoimikairakoneiden markkinoilla. Markkinakartoituksen perusteella hankinnan kohde on määriteltävissä riittävän selkeästi tarjouskilpailun toteuttamista varten. Markkinavuoropuhelussa ei tullut esiin sellaisia vaatimuksia tai menettelyyn liittyviä tekijöitä, joiden arvioitaisiin perusteettomasti rajoittavan kilpailun toteutumista. Kartoituksessa saatuja havaintoja on hyödynnetty hankinnan kohteen määrittelyssä, hankinnan rakenteessa, soveltuvuusvaatimusten asettamisessa, tarjousten vertailuperusteiden määrittelyssä. Hankinnan valmistelussa on huomioitu hankintalain 65 §:n mukaiset markkinakartoitusta koskevat periaatteet ja hankintayksikkö katsoo valmistelun tukevan kilpailun toteutumista. Hankinnan jakaminen osiin Hankintayksikkö on arvioinut hankinnan jakamista osiin. Hankintaa ei ole jaettu osiin, koska kyseessä on kertaluontoinen hankinta, jota ei ole mahdollista jakaa osiin. Hankintayksikkö katsoo, että jakamatta jättäminen on hankinnan luonne, toteutustapa ja tarkoituksenmukainen toteutus huomioon ottaen perusteltua.

title: TBIPS SA - I.9. System Administrator and I.10. Technical Architect
description: The Office of the Secretary to the Governor General (OSGG) Information Technology Directorate is responsible for all information technology systems, including their deployment, maintenance and support. These systems include, but are not limited to, servers, desktops, applications, networks, messaging, virtualization, security, storage, authentication services, Virtual Private Networks (VPNs) and cloud computing/networking. While the OSGG IT Directorate provides day-to-day operational support for the IT environment, certain requirements involving high-priority incidents, complex infrastructure issues, specialized technical expertise, or time-limited initiatives exceed the capacity or expertise available internally. The OSGG requires access to a flexible source of specialized technical expertise, on an as-requested basis through Task Authorizations, to support the resolution of priority incidents, infrastructure and cloud initiatives, system optimization activities, technical planning, architecture services, documentation, and knowledge transfer requirements. Canada may require a team of up to five (5) resources under the following TBIPS resource categories: Two (2) I.9 System Administrator (Level 3) resources; and Three (3) I.10 Technical Architect (Level 3) resources. Services may involve network, infrastructure, cloud, storage, security and related technologies within the OSGG environment and will be performed through Task Authorizations issued on an as-and-when-requested basis.

title: Facet Coater
description: For over two decades, the Canadian Photonics Fabrication Centre (CPFC) at the National Research Council of Canada (NRC) has operated as a mission-critical facility supporting Canada’s photonics and semiconductor innovation ecosystem. The CPFC provides advanced fabrication and metrology services for both internal research programs and external clients, enabling the development and production of cutting-edge photonic devices used in telecommunications, sensing, and quantum technologies. Photonic devices are critical pieces of hardware for high-performance computing in various innovative fields such as artificial intelligence (AI), data centres, automotive LiDARs (Light Detection and Ranging), biomedical, aerospace; security, and quantum industry/applications. The global market for compound semiconductor foundry services is growing rapidly, presenting niche opportunities and challenges for Canada. Limited access to compound semiconductor foundry services poses several challenges to develop, successfully introduce, and supply new products in an increasingly competitive marketplace. Photonic devices fabricated on InP wafers must undergo several “back-end” steps before dicing and packaging, adding time and cost if the assembled parts are then found to be defective. This project will establish the capability at CPFC to deliver known good die (KGD) to clients, to reduce time and cost for new product introduction (NPI). To provide KGD, a new clean room (ISO 6) will be constructed (retrofit of a current facility) to house numerous automated tools, such as Dual Ion Beam Sputter Deposition (DIBS) Laser Facet Coating Systems. This project will address an immediate client need for timely introduction of new products into a competitive marketplace.

title: Purchase of two (2) Millimetre-Wave Frequency Extender Modules for a Vector Network Analyzers (VNAs) from 110 GHz to 170 GHz
description: NRC Herzberg Astronomy and Astrophysics (HAA) requires extended measurement capabilities in the millimetre-wave frequency range to support ongoing research in characterizing front-end components for low-noise receivers in radio astronomy. Existing Vector Network Analyzers (VNAs) at NRC HAA are currently limited to a maximum operational frequency of 116 GHz. To increase its measurement capability, NRC HAA intends to acquire frequency extender modules covering the 110–170 GHz band. These extenders must integrate with either of HAA's existing analysers (Keysight PNA N5227B and Rohde & Schwarz ZNA67), providing high dynamic range and stable two-port measurements.

title: Mediator Consultant - Manitoba for the Farm Debt Mediation Service (FDMS)
description: The Programs Branch (PB) of Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada (AAFC) has requirements on an "as and when requested" basis for professional resources with expertise and skillsets for the delivery of financial counselling and mediation services. This requirement is to establish a Task Authorization Contract with a qualified Contractor's for services in Manitoba. It is intended to result in the award of 4 (four) contracts for 5 (five) years. The Farm Debt Mediation Service (FDMS) offers free financial counselling and mediation services to farmers who are having difficulties meeting their financial obligations. It is a voluntary, private and confidential service that brings farmers and their creditors together with a Mediator in a neutral forum to reach a mutually acceptable solution. The FDMS Administrator will assign a Financial Consultant and a Mediator to work with the farmer through the mediation process. Confidentiality is extremely important to the quality and effectiveness of the service. Information obtained from the farmer and their creditor(s) is used for the sole purpose of mediation and is shared only among the parties involved in the mediation process. The Mediator will facilitate communication between the farmer and their creditor(s), guide them through the mediation process, and remain neutral throughout. The Mediator will work collaboratively with the Financial Consultant to understand the context of the file, including the recovery plan developed by the farmer and the Financial Consultant. The Mediator will lead the mediation meeting and work with the parties toward a mutually acceptable solution. When the farmer and their creditor(s) reach an agreement, the Mediator will prepare the written arrangement and obtain the signatures of all participants

title: ET022-270284 Fuel Storage Tank System Replacement - Jasper National Park
description: Please note that late submissions will not be considered or accepted. Notice to suppliers: This solicitation of offers is subject to the Policy on Reciprocal Procurement. SUMMARY: Public Works and Government Services Canada (PWGSC - PSPC), on behalf of Parks Canada (PC) is seeking to retain a Contractor to provide construction services associated with the decommissioning and replacement of two fuel storage tank systems (FSTS) at the maintenance compound and one FSTS at Maligne Lake in Jasper National Park in Alberta. Temporary fueling during construction for one tank at the maintenance compound will also be required. Canada will hold an optional Bidders’ conference virtually on MS Teams on Tuesday, November 10, 2026 from 10:00 AM to 12:00 noon MDT. Participation in this conference is optional but highly recommended.

title: EC015-270889 Miramichi Pay Center - High Density Mobile Storage
description: This Public Works and Government Services of Canada on behalf of Miramichi Pay Center solicitation and resulting contract are issued against the Supply Arrangement (SA) series E60HN-21HDMS, general stream, all terms and conditions of the SA apply. Provide new HDMS in the following category: Mechanical Mobile. This requirement is for the design, delivery and installation of three (3) high density filing system meetings all specifications, codes and standards outlined in Supply Arrangement (SA) series E60HN-21HDMS.
